postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit whose second parent is the upstream branch
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: the upstream branch is now contained in HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: nothing is left uncommitted or conflicted
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_merge

postconditions.description: lines the local side removed relative to the merge base are still absent
postconditions.name: local_removals_preserved
postconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
bad=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  git cat-file -e "$mb:$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD^1:$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  removed=$(comm -23 <(git show "$mb:$f" | sort) <(git show "HEAD^1:$f" | sort))
  [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
  if printf '%s\n' "$removed" | grep -Fqx -f - <(git show "HEAD:$f"); then
    bad=1
  fi
done < <(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
[ "$bad" -eq 0 ]

postconditions.description: lines upstream added relative to the merge base are present after the merge
postconditions.name: upstream_additions_included

preconditions.description: no staged, unstaged or untracked changes before the update
preconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: the repository is not already in the middle of a merge
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: a remote-tracking ref for the upstream branch exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_present

preconditions.description: HEAD has commits upstream lacks and upstream has commits HEAD lacks
preconditions.name: branch_diverged_from_upstream

preconditions.description: some file was changed in content by both the local branch and upstream since the merge base
preconditions.name: shared_file_changed_on_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
| while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    a=$(git diff --numstat "$mb" HEAD -- "$f" | awk '{n += $1 + $2} END {print n + 0}')
    b=$(git diff --numstat "$mb" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} -- "$f" | awk '{n += $1 + $2} END {print n + 0}')
    [ "$a" -gt 0 ] && [ "$b" -gt 0 ] && echo "$f"
  done \
| grep -q .
